title: datmissingsock
tagline: did you ever lose a sock in the wash machine? own a DMS (datmissingsock) NFT to get a lifetime of sock supply if you ever lose one!
description: Socks 4eva get lost in the washing machine. Owning a DMS (datmissingsock) NFT allows a lifetime redemption of socks if the owner ever loses one. This is an example of NFT as a utility token that allows its owners to access socks redemption. On top of that, if users do now want to redeem a sock, they can also connect with a lonesock in the ecosystem to make a pair / a bundle of lost sock.
how_its_made: Mapping out the idea and use case for datmissingsock via Figma. Technologies I intend to use would be smart contract via solidity to allow users to redeem a sock and get it mailed to them if they ever lose a sock. Users get to sign in via google via Web3Auth and also WalletConnect for rest of the web3 users.
